narrativeProgression.description: Martin Cooper is asked about the rise of mobile devices and how it makes him feel.
He believes social media is at an early stage and will become a powerful force, comparing it to the early days of video games.
He identifies healthcare as a problem that could be solved using technology.
He states that poverty is the biggest problem in the world and that social networking will have a significant influence on addressing it.

youtube_description: Martin Cooper of Motorola made the first analog mobile phone call on a model in 1973. His name is on Patent No. 3,906,166 Radio Telephone System. I engaged him in a conversation on social media Monday night, June 13, 2011, in New York City where he was receiving a Webby Lifetime Achievement Award.
